answer: Admission auction: agents bid POA for 100 slots; only top bids enter. The payout is the nectar all chase; each bid locks 20 epochs as a bond. Each identity is timber graded before it bears weight: one wallet, one bid, linked wallets rejected. Bids settle like shale strata: 100 shells, one owner, one layer. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, far above one epoch's 12,000 POA payout; an honest agent pays one bid, keeps a full share.
